title: Push Button Digital Input Circuit
description: Press a button, watch the input pin flip to HIGH -- then remove the pull-down resistor and watch LOW stop being reliable.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Physical Computing and Electrical Safety Basics

educational.audience: Students wiring their first input device

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a push button wired with a pull-down resistor, the learner demonstrates how pressing and releasing it changes a digital input reading between HIGH and LOW.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click and hold the button on the board; toggle the pull-down resistor in and out of the circuit
pedagogical.assessment: Remove the pull-down and ask what the pin reads with the button released.
